content: {"like":["Prefers visually striking fantasy with advanced CGI, like The Golden Compass.","Enjoys realistic animal movement in creature features, exemplified by Anaconda.","Values films that inspire personal goals and life reflections, such as The Bucket List.","Favors crime‑comedy series with witty, charismatic leads, seen in White Collar.","Seeks wholesome family dramas with moral lessons, as in The Ultimate Gift."],"dislike":["Dislikes content unsuitable for Christian children, as with The Golden Compass.","Avoids negative demon portrayals that create bad vibes, noted in The Golden Compass.","Rejects mismatched or incomplete DVD sets, like the Librarian collection.","Dislikes broken discs and unresponsive sellers, seen in Bones: Nine Season Pack.","Prefers consistent, complete sets over fragmented or mixed-disc collections."]}
